purpose: Source-bound paired runtime measurements; never an automatic tolerance approval
candidate_rule: Twice the measured absolute paired discrepancy of the declared field statistic, rounded up to its printed precision. Report only; not a universal bound.
strict_policy: Source, seed sets, populations, parameter counts, schedules, algebraic identities and existing near-zero gates are not loosened. Seed SD is descriptive prose, never a tolerance bound.

ch08.field_statistic: Single seed 6050 accuracy, probability units; convert to percentage points only for percent-formatted stdout. No inferred extra replicates.

ch11.field_statistic: Per-seed errors and accuracy; fixed-five-seed mean, sample SD, and paired FR-TF contrast are distinct reported statistics. Initialization and schedule identities remain exact.

ch13.field_statistic: Test and curve summaries use the five seeds. Routing uses seed 6050 only: mean of 1600 year masses, mean of 1600 binary top-key indicators, maximum of 400 row errors. Row-sum error is a normalization identity, not an argmax fraction; its existing <1e-6 gate remains unchanged.

ch19.field_statistic: Each metric has five raw seed values and the actual float64 Torch mean/sample-SD reductions. The failing no-time generated-mean field is the mean of five seed means, not a seed-SD bound. The within-generated-sample standard deviation (population correction=0) and across-training-seed sample SD (correction=1) are different statistics. Existing 2e-6 and algebraic/near-zero gates are not changed.
